noAnchorGaps.concept: Alternative entry on a higher low
noAnchorGaps.quote: or wait for price to set a higher low and enter there
noAnchorGaps.why: move trade_setup_long exposes only entry/stop/target (all level anchors) and no point anchor for a 'higher low' pullback; it is a passing aside, not the beat's core reference

notes: Verified all three CHART/CANDLE beats against ground-truth anchors. level: 'level' level on level(L) and marker on touch1(pt) are valid and match the say ('mark our level — a zone we believe will act as support', 'wait patiently for price to come back and test it'). trigger: regions of lowerWick and body are valid CANDLE regions for long_lower_wick and match 'long lower wick, buyers aggressively bidding' / 'buyers dominate — the trigger'. entry: entry/stop/target levels (all valid L anchors) plus risk/reward zones on entry match the say; nothing redundant or missing. The auditor's single noAnchorGap is correct — 'higher low' has no point anchor in trade_setup_long and is a passing aside, so recorded not invented. No fixes, no added gaps. Lesson needs nothing.
